description: Server-side JavaScript code for a database visualization dashboard, implementing API endpoints for connecting to various databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB), loading environment variables, and managing database adapters.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database adapters, providing interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and fetching data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter for SQL-based databases, implementing execute, getTables, and getData methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, executing queries via node-postgres Pool.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, executing queries via mysql2/promise connection.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, executing queries using sqlite3 module.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, managing connections and data retrieval via mongodb driver.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different database types.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and returns list of available ones.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing database operations and returning JSON responses.
